protocol.input: Unmodified publisher RescaleT(320) and ToTensorLab(flag=0): stretch the complete RGB image, image-maximum scaling and ImageNet channel normalization. EXIF orientation applied before source hash checks.
protocol.output: Publisher fused saliency head with per-image minimum/maximum normalization, threshold .5 for locator; constant field becomes zero.
protocol.pipeline: Same RGB classifier, locator support gates and 10-second fitter. Preserve every supported production crop and require observed corners before fallback replacement.
protocol.selection: All sixteen existing development photos. No manual prompts, result-dependent case selection, model training or checkpoint selection.

scope: Exploratory frozen pretrained saliency baseline on the already inspected cohort. U2NETP checkpoint from the author-linked Google Drive, code at pinned official Git commit. No heart fine-tuning. Upstream pretraining overlap with public photos is unknown. Not a deployable or browser-validated model.
